ja367:1.1: Yo 'yaṃ sāliyachāpo ti kaṇhasappaṃ agāhayi tena sappen' ayaṃ daṭṭho hato pāpānusāsako.
ja367:2.1: Ahanantam ahantāraṃ yo naro hantum icchati evaṃ so nihato seti yathāyaṃ puriso hato.
ja367:3.1: Ahanantaṃ aghātentaṃ yo naro hantum icchati evaṃ so nihato seti yathāyaṃ puriso hato.
ja367:4.1: Yathā paṃsumuṭṭhiṃ puriso paṭivātaṃ paṭikkhipe tam eva so rajo hanti yathāyaṃ puriso hato.
ja367:5.1: Yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati (Dhp. v. 125.) suddhassa posassa anaṅgaṇassa tam eva bālaṃ pacceti pāpaṃ sukhumo rajo paṭivātaṃ va khitto ti
